notes: Signed and notarised by Apple: the installer opens with a double click. Two zips instead of one, so a Mac no longer downloads a Windows build. Pads play at the octave they were recorded at. GHOST shifts by phase vocoder and the octave up no longer crackles. Star a preset and it joins the favourites shelf. The library opens full-window, with tag families, an ALL shelf and the last fifty SUMMON invocations. SUMMON never draws one-shot. Nine presets join ASTRAL.
